title: Tom Yum Goong
description: A hot and sour prawn soup — lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaf in a quick shell stock, sharpened with lime and chilli jam.
notes: Stir in 100 ml of evaporated milk at the end for the creamy nam khon version.

steps.text: Peel the prawns, keeping the tails on, and simmer the shells and heads in the water for a quick stock. Strain.
Add the lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves and simmer to infuse.
steps.tip: None of these are eaten. They are there for fragrance and get pushed to the side of the bowl.

steps.text: Add the oyster mushrooms and chillies, then the prawns, and cook just until they turn pink.
Off the heat, stir in the fish sauce, nam prik pao, and lime juice. Taste — sour first, then salty, then hot. Finish with cilantro.
steps.tip: Lime juice goes in off the heat. Boiled, it turns bitter.
